_comment: Risk factors and age/sex modifiers for disease scoring

risk_factors.name: History of Tobacco Smoking
risk_factors.description: Active or past significant tobacco cigarette smoking

risk_factors.name: Known History of Asthma
risk_factors.description: Prior clinical diagnosis of reactive airway or asthma

risk_factors.name: Recent Travel to Tropical/Endemic Region
risk_factors.description: Travel to mosquito-endemic areas within last 14 days

risk_factors.name: Close Contact with Confirmed Sick Individual
risk_factors.description: Exposure to someone with acute respiratory or viral illness

risk_factors.name: Recent Antibiotic Use
risk_factors.description: Antibiotic regimen completed within last 30 days
